name: Nasdaq Data Link (formerly Quandl)
description: Nasdaq Data Link, formerly Quandl, provides free and premium financial, economic, and alternative datasets through multiple APIs and analysis tools.
agentUseSummary: Nasdaq Data Link is unavailable for generic Relay installation because its standard data license restricts redistribution and prohibits using licensed data in a software-as-a-service, cloud, or other technology service unless an applicable agreement grants broader rights. Relay mounts no tools, requests no API key, and does not expose free, premium, table, time-series, streaming, SQL, bulk, or raw data access.

blocked.label: Block unlicensed data APIs
blocked.description: Time-series, tables, real-time or delayed REST, streaming, SQL, SDK, Excel, search, metadata, and other free or premium dataset access are unavailable without written rights covering Relay's cloud and agent use.

blocked.label: Block downloads, exports, and redistribution
blocked.description: Rows, columns, historical observations, bulk downloads, table exports, files, derived substitutes, caching, persistence, retransmission, redistribution, and external sharing are unavailable.

blocked.label: Block credentials and workaround access
blocked.description: API keys, account or subscription access, cookies, browser automation, undocumented or legacy Quandl hosts, arbitrary datasets, paths, filters, queries, pagination, retries, and raw browser or HTTP tools are unavailable.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No Nasdaq Data Link actions are available without an approved data licence and connection contract.

runtimeSupport.description: No Nasdaq Data Link wrapper is mounted without a written agreement authorizing Relay's SaaS/cloud agent use and the applicable dataset rights.
No Nasdaq Data Link wrapper is mounted without a written agreement authorizing Relay's SaaS/cloud agent use and the applicable dataset rights.

providerSetup.blocker: Nasdaq Data Link's standard data license limits use to the applicable agreement and prohibits redistribution and SaaS, cloud, or other technology-service use. Dataset-specific and third-party terms may add restrictions. Relay has no reviewed order form or written grant authorizing a generic installable cloud-agent connector.
providerSetup.nextAction: Keep Nasdaq Data Link unpublished unless Nasdaq and every applicable data licensor grant Relay written rights covering SaaS/cloud agent processing, API access, transient display, retention, derived output, redistribution boundaries, and each intended dataset. Then re-run full provider research against the executed agreement.

evidence.supports: Nasdaq documents free and premium financial data products delivered through streaming, time-series, and tables APIs, with most datasets requiring individual subscriptions.
Nasdaq documents legacy Quandl time-series REST routes, API-key authentication, dataset codes, metadata and data responses, and bulk-download capabilities.
Nasdaq documents authenticated and anonymous API limits plus separate bulk-download limits, confirming that access remains subject to account, subscription, and service controls.

Nasdaq's standard data license limits use to the applicable order form, requires compliance with third-party terms, restricts retransmission and redistribution, and prohibits use in a software-as-a-service, cloud, or other technology service.
Nasdaq publishes the current privacy policy applicable to users of its sites, products, and services.
